proposal.observation: v5_auto (Na-ion) has no baseline yet. The paper reports CPMLP on Na-ion with its own selected hyper-parameters (Selected_hyperparameters.md).
proposal.primary_hypothesis: CPMLP with the paper Na-ion configuration, trained under the locked Relative Huber loss, gives a valid reference with finite connected gradients on the tiny Na-ion split (20 train / 6 val cells).
proposal.question_inherited: What is the valid CPMLP baseline for Na-ion split 2021 under the v5 locked workflow?
proposal.why_this_experiment: Every later Na-ion model needs a same-loss, same-split CPMLP reference; NA-E001/E002 repeat it on splits 42/2024.
proposal.modification: CPMLP (d_model 64, d_ff 32, e_layers 1, d_layers 9, dropout 0; paper Na-ion row) on BL_SPLIT=2021, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-5, batch 128 (paper 64 x 2 GPUs), up to 100 epochs with patience 5 (paper CPMLP.sh). Runs on Colab CUDA.
proposal.changed_components: Relative to v4 R4-E000: dataset (Na-ion), CPMLP size, batch 128, epochs 100 (one epoch is only ~15 steps), diagnostics every 50 steps, CUDA device.
proposal.held_constant_components: Relative Huber delta 0.15, checkpoint MAPE tolerance 0.005, no scheduler, zero physics or extra loss, prefix samples 1..min(100, EOL-1), preprocessing identical to v4/BatteryLife.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: One selected checkpoint with overall MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, RMSE, per-cell errors for all 6 val cells, prefix and EOL-band errors, gradient health.
proposal.rejection_condition: Invalid if protocol/cache checks fail, values are non-finite, a block is disconnected, fewer than 5 epochs run, the loss differs from Relative Huber 0.15, or checkpoint selection breaks the fixed rule.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; CPMLP block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.

result.description: CPMLP (d_model 64, d_ff 32, e_layers 1, d_layers 9, dropout 0; paper Na-ion row) on BL_SPLIT=2021, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-5, batch 128 (paper 64 x 2 GPUs), up to 100 epochs with patience 5 (paper CPMLP.sh). Runs on Colab CUDA.
